notes.title: Get ready to descend into the abyss...
notes.content:
[h2]Subterrain: Mines of Titan is available NOW![/h2]

We do realize here, that many of you expressing that this isn't Subterrain 2 and are not interested with the game. We get that. For those, we still want to thank you for still supporting Subterrain and we REALLY do hope that one day, we can come back to the original Subterrain 2. When that will be? we can't say today. But one thing is for sure, and that is we have made through another game and still here! Following the original path of Subterrain is one of my life goal and God willing, I may see it happening one day.

But today is different day. Today, we humbly release our next game. Subterrain: Mines of Titan.

For anyone who is interested, please treat this game as completely different game that shares Subterrain universe.

Again we offer a massive thank you to everyone who's been part of this incredible journey through the years of development. The mystery of Titan beckons, and we can't wait for you to uncover its secrets.

[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=st7tUfeurRA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]🔍 Uncover the Secrets of Titan[/h3]
Embark on a quest for survival as you confront the lurking horrors below. Will you craft equipment, research new gear, fight against overwhelming odds, or uncover your true fate? Titan, an unrelenting world, demands your resilience, and every step you take advances time. Only you can intervene to prevent the collapse of Camp Huygens.

[h3]🌑 Survival Management[/h3]
Survive the unforgiving environment of Titan by managing resources, tracking time, and exploring abandoned mining tunnels. The fate of Camp Huygens rests on your shoulders.

[h3]⚔️ Turn-Based Combat[/h3]
Confront monstrous foes with brisk, intuitive turn-based combat. Choose your approach—close and personal or strategic plinking from afar. Harness the power of nanomachines, evolve alongside creatures, and adapt tactics to conquer Titan's mines.

[h3]🔧 Crafting System[/h3]
Craft an arsenal of items, salvage materials, and produce tools, weapons, protective gear, explosives, and survival upgrades. Enhance yourself with medical supplies and continue research to unearth the terrible truth.


[hr][/hr]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1573100/Subterrain_Mines_of_Titan/

[h3]💰 Celebrate & Save During Launch[/h3]
To celebrate the game's launch, Subterrain: Mines of Titan will be [b]10% off until March 28th![/b] Now is the perfect time to begin your adventure on Titan and determine Camp Huygens fate.

[h3]💞 How You Can Support Us[/h3]
As a small indie team, there are so many ways you can help support us and the game.
[list][*] If you buy the game, please consider leaving an honest review on Steam! Reviews have a massive impact on indie games and we'd love to see your thoughts and experiences through a review.
[*] Sharing the game through word of mouth with family and friends or on social media with your followers can really help spread the word and give others a chance to discover their next adventure. So many indies are discovered with a simple share or casual discussion.
[*] Join the amazing community in our [url=http://discord.gg/ERRSBJafXZ]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/pixellore]Twitter[/url] to share in the excitement and get to know other adventurous gamers exploring Titan.
[/list]

Thank you for your support!

The mystery of Titan beckons! 
[b]Pixellore🛠️🔦[/b]

notes.title: Subterrain coming to XboxOne and PS4
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8292342/bb74b95ff7342f889b394144158cf6daddc7fd14.png[/img]

Hi everyone.

I realize this is Steam and some of you are probably not interested in this news, but I have the best community here for Subterrain so I would like to share the news.

[h1]
Subterrain is coming to [b]XboxOne[/b] and [b]PS4[/b] on [b]27th Jan 2017[/b] next year.
[/h1]

It has been a real tough job to port the game as I had to do it all alone. And I wanted to try and make it world wide release on two major platforms at the same time so it was a lot harder than I have expected it. The process has actually helped to fix many minor glitches with the game, especially with the controllers.

I have been porting the game at the same time trying to come up with interesting stuff for the next title. I hope I can share something more before the end of the year but we will just have to see.

I hope some of you would be interested or at least tell your friends about it.

Thanks always!

[h1]Release Note : Version 1152 24 Oct 2016[/h1]

- Fixed : Other localization issue.

- Fixed : Re-enforced the check for power status on various facility controllers including remotes.

- Updated : Improved readbility of journal by adding more line spacing.

[h1]Release Note : Version 1151 20 Oct 2016[/h1]

BETA 

- Fixed : Spanish tutorial controller image had missing texts

- Fixed : UI button images for the controller was not changing correctly upon connection/disconnection. (1150 bug)

[h1]Release Note : Version 1150 19 Oct 2016[/h1]

BETA 

- Fixed : West not disappearing first before tube door closes. 

- Fixed : Researching small bag wasn't giving the ability to produce one itself. 

- Updated : Remote control access has been changed so that only Hardcore and Nightmare difficulty mode has the restriction of needing level 2 software. 

- Updated : Slightly updated base layout. Added new repair machine (slots still shared) near the generator room. Added research remote control machines. This will only apply for the new games that starts with version 1150. This means everything is accessible completely from the base. 

- Updated : There is whole new set of useful location icons for data chips and other mission critical items. This shows on the minimap regardless of map fog exploration status. This will help a lot to not miss the critical items.

1. West needs to have obtained and read relevant log journal entries before the icons show on the map. 

2. West needs to have at least visited the same area map as the icon. ie : icons will not show for the maps that West has never been to. This is enforced by the fact that West can't view any maps that he has not been to.

Thanks!

notes.title: Upcoming Soundtrack DLC and Deluxe version.
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

People has suggested to create Sound track DLC and I thought it was a great idea! so it is coming soon on 26th May!

[url]http://store.steampowered.com/app/470670/[/url]

I know it isn't a content update, but if you would like to support the development , be the update for the Subterrain or the next game from Pixellore, please feel free to buy it.

I am also working on a deluxe version of the game with the DLC as the same purchase with a bit of discount when bought together. I am working on it to be released at the same time as the OST DLC.

[h1]Lighting system update[/h1]
As for the update of the game, I am currently working hard on the all new lighting system that I wanted to do for very long time which will boost rendering performance a lot. I have almost finished it and I will release it as usual beta branch first.

[h1]Optimization and code refactoring[/h1]
There is a lots of work under way for the preparation to port the game to different platforms. The platforms that I am going to port the game to are :
Xbox One, PS4 and possibly Linux and Mac release.

[h1]Bug fixes and localization[/h1]
Usual bug fixes while refactorying the code base and I am looking to polish up the localization as well.

I have not been updating the game as often as I used to , and that is because the new lighting system rework takes long time to do. But I think it was worth it!

As always, thanks for the support and I hope to post another news soon!

notes.title: Major content update release!
notes.content:
[h1]Major content update code name "Purification" is now released![/h1]

[b]Without too much spoiler, the update is all about: [/b]

[list]
[*]Extended game play that let you experience personal story line of Dr.West.
[*]Epic boss battles with heart pounding new music scores!
[*]Better overall game play experience by the tightening up the previous first part of the game.
[*]Random floor generation. Now the important items are found in randomly shuffled floors.
[*]Voice over for the all cut scenes!
[*]More achievements and leaderboard types.
[*]More endings!
[*]Many other minor bug fixes over the previous version.
[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/lyrUgpM.jpg[/img]

Check out the new trailer here or at the Subterrain store : 

[url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qNKtVA__7Tc[/url]

As we have promised, it is a free update to those of you who has bought the game already. No DLC stuff!

We really hope you enjoy the extended version of the game!

I would like to thank those of you who has contributed directly and indirectly to the update. It would not have been possible without your efforts! You guys rule!

Previous save game is more or less compatible with the updated game if the version the game has started isn't too old. I think any save game that has started since version 107x should be ok.

However, it is always best and safe to play the new game from the beginning.

Thank you! and if you have any questions just let us know in the forum as always.

notes.title: Purification official update date
notes.content:
Hi Everyone.

I would like to move the beta version of the purification update to default game on 4th of May.

There still be some bugs and polishing to do and localization is not yet completed, but I want to move on so that more players can play it.

This means that the price of the game will be up by $2 on 4th of May.

I hope this update can really bring some better experience for everyone.

I would also like to thank to those of you who visited us on PAX EAST game show.

I am currently making a new trailer that goes with the purification update and that will be uploaded as well.

After the purification update, I want to just focus on the bug fixing and platform support such as Linux or Mac port and the other console ports.

There will not be anymore update as far as the contents goes. As much as I love to continue developing Subterrain, I have to find the way to make living and that means I have to try and port the game to the other platforms as soon as I can.

I have very exciting other projects in mind and I will be more than willing to share them with the community of Subterrain.

Thank you and if you have any problems with purification update, just give me a shout.

notes.title: Update 1042
notes.content:
We are working through series of BETA builds to fix some bugs and working on the major purification update. There will be separate purification branch to test that update for the invited party. More news on this will follow.

Thanks!

[h1]Release Note : Version 1042 24 Feb 2016[/h1]

[b] BETA [/b]

- Fixed : Sometimes tram won't arrive (but you can still spawn on the platform.

- Fixed : Strange Viking plaza show cases not lootable bug. I still don't know what causes it but I have implemented safe measure to correct it after the game's load.

- Fixed : Turret status label localization position issue.

- Updated : Item description can now have line breaker. Thanks for the suggestion!

- Updated : Dragging items from inventory into tactical slots will now work regardless of the item category. This is new feature so it is subject to some bugs.

- Updated : Infection rate calculation has changed a bit. The locations has better min o2 and temperature and it has some effects on the infection rate. The old save games may have some wrong values in them. But all future new games should have this update.

[h1]Release Note : Version 1041 24 Feb 2016[/h1]

[b] BETA [/b]

- Fixed : Cancelling crafting process only returned materials for 1 item.

- Updated : Updated various localization files. Thanks guys.

We are in the middle of creating purification update. So there "could" be some bugs creeping into the game while we are adding the features and polishing them.

[h1]Release Note : Version 1040 21 Feb 2016[/h1]

- Fixed : Another attempt to fix forever invasion. It should always end invasion now.

[h1]Release Note : Version 1039 20 Feb 2016[/h1]

[b] BETA [/b]

- Fixed : Another attempt to fix "Box" title for the containers. These fixes may not work properly for other types (eg dumpsters)

- Updated : Vsync option now requires a restart to prevent losing mapping on some computer.

- Updated : Attempt to make minimap rendering faster by reducing texture size from 2k to 1k. This is experimental.

- Updated : Item detail stats description can now be in multi line.

- Updated : Removed a room design that can cause disappearing of its funiture objects.

[h1]Release Note : Version 1038 19 Feb 2016[/h1]

[b] BETA [/b]

- Fixed : Player icon not disappearing when hud minimap transparency was set to 0.

- Fixed : Mine and farm queue had wrong queue limit text on level 4.

- Fixed : Wrong icon sprite for vodka.

- Fixed : Wrong icon for the crafting facilities.

- Fixed : Possible fix for localization issue for the container titles.

- Updated : Switch around crafting facilities so they are more consistent with the others.

- Updated : New wall rendering for minimap! I think part of the reason why some people are having difficult times locating the chips etc is that the minimap could sometimes be over looked so that the player was thinking they had explored the area. Now with wall rendering this confusion will be greatly reduced. However, this comes at the cost of some performance. Nothing modern pc can't handle, but it still needs to render the walls again.

- Updated : Changed fog texture format from jpg to png file. This could reduce save game size a bit in some cases and produces better loseless fog maps. This change was required for the minimap wall rendering.

notes.title: New Central control map
notes.content:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CbGdo82UcAApzZH.jpg:large[/img]

[h1]Release Note : Version 1034 13 Feb 2016[/h1]

[h1] BETA [/h1]

- Fixed : Warning UI popping up during loading level screen.

- Fixed : West's vision range not changing according to the zoom level.

- Fixed : Temperature recovery rate was totally wrong.

- Updated : New Central control map layout! Added remote control room for production. It works the same as remote mine and farm. It needs to have level 2 software on the engineering to work. Previous save game will have old Central control map for compatibility.

- Updated : Weapons stat balancing and adjustment.

- Updated : Slight more optimization for mobs not nearby player.


[h1]Release Note : Version 1033 11 Feb 2016[/h1]

- Fixed : Interact Icon is persistent when switching from one object to another.

- Fixed : Murray Space Center door sprite bug.

- Fixed : For perm death continue button is not disappearing.

- Fixed : Possible fix for inventory lower bar overlapping with the last slot.

- Updated : Updated corridoor room pieces so that they have more balanced mobs spawn. This will also help with massive number of mobs waiting outside the first stairs door.

- Updated : Perm death is now optionally selectable at the start new game UI.

- Updated : Performance optimization for mobs not nearby player. This method uses hard culling so there could be some bugs relating to this.

- Updated : AI update for spitter class mobs. It will try to get close to the player so that it doesn't get stuck in the corner, and has relatively weak melee attacks when close to the player.

- Updated : Tweaked shoot rate and damage value for all ranged weapons. Pistols and shotguns shoot faster with less damage. Pistols builds up heat quicker. SMG damage is higher for lower tier and lower for higher tier. Plasma launcher has faster firing rate for higher tier.

- Updated : Disabled cycling gathering minigun game play to properly test the new weapon balance. Sorry boys!

The new weapon balance is very experimental. So they are subject to change.


[h1]Release Note : Version 1032 10 Feb 2016[/h1]

- Fixed : Hover tool tip not working.

- Updated : Updated French localization.

- Updated : All tool tip stats are round to nearest integer instead of trunc.


[h1]Release Note : Version 1031 09 Feb 2016[/h1]

- Fixed : Overlapping containers in shopping plaza room.

- Fixed : Slight icon issue when viewing container and then non container close by.

- Fixed : Disabled the power recharger icon on section status, because it was dropped some time ago.

- Fixed : Removed two rooms with medium bag spawning.

- Updated : Changed font used for French language.

- Updated : Possible fix/re-enforcement for continue button for warning UI not being selected when using controller.

- Updated : Changed version number from 1.x.x.x format to 1xxx  format. This is to prepare for the upcoming updates and it will be used to do some backward compatibility.


[h1]Release Note : Version 1.0.3.0  09 Feb 2016[/h1]

- Fixed : Level number text not showing for the first time opening crafting ui.

- Fixed : Cosmetic - Research/Manufacturing complete titles reversed

- Fixed : Spliting a pile does not work as intended

- Fixed : Non-interactable console in elevator control room (for future new games)

- Updated : Implemented multi level zooming. Also reduced the highest zoom level down as it seemed to be unnecessary too high. Also hopefully this solves issue with visions leaking out causing the map revealing to be messed up.

Localization

UI_text

new = system_Lv

if localized version of short abbreviations Level (Lv) is the same as English (Lv) then there is nothing to change.


[h1]Release Note : Version 1.0.2.9  07 Feb 2016[/h1]

This update has got mostly to do with controller. Reflecting recent feedback from one of the review. Thanks!

- Fixed : Controller selection issue with inventory. (selection sprite)

- Fixed : Losing inventory selection on any of production completion notice.

- Fixed : Showing minimap immediately after loading a new level causing it to reveal all for a brief moment.

- Updated : Implemented some dead zone for moving with controller. This should help the controllers with less accurate calibration.

- Updated : Inverted controller direction for panning mini map. Hopefully for the last time!


[h1]Release Note : Version 1.0.2.8  06 Feb 2016[/h1]

- Fixed : Fix for Italian lauguage option causing main menu to not function properly after restarting the game.

- Fixed : Minor UI fixes.

- Updated : Game over continue now opens up save slot choice UI as requested.

- Updated : Russian and some English update. Thanks to everyone contributing.

I really want to say that our team of passionate players who are responsible for the localization of the game.
It's is a lot of work, and while we know that sometimes, the translation may not be perfect.. but I am sure there are many of us who appricate it more than otherwise. Please keep going as long as you can!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.3
notes.content:
Just came back from Taipei game show!

It was cool to visite Taiwan and check out many other cool games and meet other developers. But I am sure I will need to get back to much needed updates so here they are!

[h1]Release Note : Version 1.0.1.3  30 Jan 2016[/h1]

- Updated : Changed mouse cursor to hardware based. This needs to be tested.

- Updated : Invasion unit number starts small and then increases per invasion.

- Updated : Invasion unit number coming through at any time during battle starts small and increases per invasion.

- Updated : Controller no longer works for movement when use controller option is not turned on.

I have just came back from Taipei game show and I sure have a lot to update! So I will do this over the next few days.

The first one is to sort out the initial stairs room. 

------

[h1]BETA BUILD[/h1]

Release Note : Version 1.0.1.2  29 Jan 2016

- Fixed : Scroll bar ui bug with all queue systems.

- Fixed : Wrong durability stats for items going in and out of reserch queue.

- Updated : Increased speed of repair, repair speed also depends on the amount of max durability that the item can be repaired to.

- Updated : Possible increase of performance for low and middle light quality settings.

- Updated : Experimental ambient lighting tied to the elevator switch. If level doesn't have one, it is considered to be turned on. This feature will work on random maps even on the old save games, but for the non random maps, it will only work for a new game, since the stats are saved.

Show at Taiwan is going well. very busy place and many many people. It would have been better if it was b2c, but I still get to see some of the other cool indie games. 

------

- Fixed : Some non repairable items such as filters being able to place in the repair bay.

- Fixed : Possible very short invasion time terms.

Everyone!

I will be attending TaiPie Game Show 2016 and be hosting a smll booth there showing Subterrain.

I will be gone from 27th till 30th and my usual update will be slow during this time.

I hope everyone at show like Subterrain!

------

notes.content:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CSzk_VfUAAE9FKS.jpg:large[/img]

It has been a frenzy time.. adding requested features, fixing bugs. Thanks to everyone reporting bugs!

[h1]Don't forget your last min Steam sale! It is the last one this year![/h1]

[h1]Release Note : Version 0.8.8.2  02 Nov 2015[/h1]

- Fixed : Bug with black out triggering during tube travel causing the warning UI to stay and cause other bugs.

- Fixed : Multiple grenades being used when throwing a grenade.

- Fixed : Research bug with laser baton and advanced bandage.

- Fixed : Sometimes cursor disappears when West dies from invasion battle.

- Update : Minimap zoom function! press zoom key to toggle minimap zoom.

- Update : Map will close if you press move key. (like inventory)

- Update : Invasion force arrival time has been increased.

- Update : Power recharger max level has been increased for Central control.

- Update : Core takes much less damage than before from invasion force.

- Update : Changed the way fog is being rendered. Small performance improvement and better minimap revealing to minimize the chance of player not realizing the area has not been discovered. The new method uses only West's vision instead of combination of light and vision.

- Update : Localized strings can now have {KEY} string and it will be replaced by the keys that are mapped using the keyboard remapping. (But we can't do anything about the tutorial tip images yet.)

map_toggle_zoom 

system_loading_tip_01 - 11 (I have tried to modify the existing tranlation with new key placeholder text)

- Fixed : Power usage upon overheated and dropping weapon didn't count.

- Update : New slider control for production UI. 3Dprinter, Biocombiner, Mine, Farm now has quuantity slider to more control on how may per queue batch you want to produce.

- Update : Rebalanced items to take account of finer control of item production.

Localization update : 

UI_Text : jobqueue_production_current_quantity, jobqueue_production_quantity

- Fixed : Grenades disappearing when it is used rapidly.

- Fixed : Tube time control UI can appear when exit to menu from tube travel scene.

- Fixed : Attempt to fix loading bug with last floor of each location. Please try and report if you still have issues.

- Update : Power pack can be used in the tactical slot using hot keys to swap them.

- Update : Placed grenades in the Central control in the storage room for easier access to them in the beginning of the game.

- Update : Item recycle yield has lable to avoid confusion between crafting requirements.

- Update : Item detail takes account of its count. So if you have 10 items that yields 10 resin, it will show 100 resin. This will hopefully make a bit easier to see if you would have enough materials during your scavenging.

notes.content:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CRlxZNlUcAAQIqt.jpg:large[/img]

[h1]Release Note : Version 0.8.6.8  18 Oct 2015[/h1]

- New : In game keyboard remapping! We have in game keyboard remapping at last! There are few keys you can't use : 

LeftWindows
RightWindows
Escape
ScrollLock
Print
Numlock
CapsLock

There may be some other keys that you can't use that we have not disabled it for, and it may cause some error if you do. We will flash it out over the time.

[h1]Release Note : Version 0.8.6.7  17 Oct 2015[/h1]

- Fixed : Fixed stat bug where a good needs condition was still causing the final body condition to become bad. ( thanks to Commander Shepard for this hard to find bug fix )

- Fixed : Door light not matching the base graphics in random map.

- Fixed : Disabled Jellyfish mob's attack when it is killed.

- Fixed : Attempt to fix crowbar madness bug. ( See forum thread ) by completely rewriting how attack logics are handled.

- Update : Increased Jellyfish's attack speed slightly.

- Update : Added slight randomness to the rotation of Jellyfish and random direction.

------

[h1]Release Note : Version 0.8.6.6  16 Oct 2015[/h1]

- Fixed : When West travel to the Central control for an invasion battle, if West dies during the fight, loaded level still thinks it is in the middle of  
invasion battle.

- Fixed : Circular invasion gauge now correctly reflects the time until the breach.

- Fixed : Destroyed core showing as -1 durability in the core slot UI, instead of empty item.

- Fixed : Research upgrade slot showing as level 1 when you load the game no matter what is actually in the slot.

- Fixed : Sometimes wrong calculation for total infection rate is displayed. (float to int conversion error)

- Fixed : Pause menu button had save button enabled during invasion battle.

- Fixed : Missing knock back attribute on melee and ranged weapon for item detail. UI_Text added.

- Update : Small child brain bugs are dies when parent dies. This should make things a bit easier if you are being overwhelmed by these bugger.

- Update : Adjusted number of invasion units according to the recent changes to the max population per level.

- Update : Added sound fx for showing warning UI.

- Update : Increased time for the invasion forces to arrive at the Central control.

- Update : Increased term for each possible invasion.

There are two stages in the invasion. First it takes different time for invasion force to arrive to the Central control. Once they have arrived, West has 3 hours to get to the base. If West does not arrive at the Central control in this 3 hours , the generator is considered to be destroyed.

When West gets to the Central control, invasion battle begins immediately. This is so that the players don't have to wait for the game play to kick in.

So actual time for a preparation is only during arrival stage. So if you guys think that this time is too short, then let me know.

------

[h1]Release Note : Version 0.8.6.5  15 Oct 2015[/h1]

- New : Final evolution level for melee and ranged mobs! We want to call this final one as pre-Martian and it is the level where both melee and ranged one evolves to. The unit still needs more polishing and add effects + sounds but we wanted to put it in the game to test it out.

- Fixed : Start button on the second stage of Biocombiner not working.

There seems to be "empty item" bugs happening in the game, but I was not able to catch when and how that happens. If someone knows how to reproduce such bug, please let me know.

On next week, I will be polishing the rooms used in the random map. Adding more and fixing the existing ones.

------

notes.title: Switching default game to new game play mode!
notes.content:
[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-f-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xfp1/v/t1.0-9/12009566_875380365883294_4419898145641538106_n.jpg?oh=218c03f80096b27d64b48a748d96331f&oe=5665CD23&__gda__=1453535402_a3281cdc35c896bda12eafb778fd4228[/img]

We would like to switch the default game branch to the new "Abyss" game play mode before going to BIC festival so today is the day it happens!

[h1]The old version of the game can still be played by enrolling into beta -> oldversion[/h1]

For those of you who are new to the Abyss mode, here is summary of the new things in the game!

[h1] New world [/h1]

[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-g-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xfl1/v/t1.0-9/11999049_875376862550311_4154604629963487186_n.jpg?oh=e72123f42bf9fb524e3c3d6fd49d1ef5&oe=56696960&__gda__=1453490530_1ba86106ddb44eace50c8301c75ed787[/img]

[list]
[*]The world of Subterrain has gotten deeper instead of widely spread as before.
[*]New randomly generated maps for casino, hotel, square, plaza and districts. They can go as deep as 10 floors.
[*]All other previously incomplete levels are now in the game, including new Murray space center.
[*]Newly added Central control level
[/list]

[h1] New enemies [/h1]

[list]
[*]Added 2 new enemy types and more evolution levels for the existing mob types.
[*]New final form of evolution will be added shortly.
[/list]

[h1] New stories [/h1]
[list]
[*]The story and missions in the game has changed completely and there are many little stories and logs that gives you hints and reveals what happened in the colony.
[*]New escape plan
[*]There will be a new core story that relates to what happened to the colony and West's personal lines.
[/list]

[h1] New game play [/h1]

[img]https://scontent.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xpt1/v/t1.0-9/12003272_875376809216983_5665506061075542271_n.jpg?oh=b5061f836a561e1b6998519093b4137e&oe=567A5CAB[/img]

[list]
[*]New weapons.
[*]Mars colony facilities such as mine, biosphere, research and engineering are upgradable.
[*]New progression system for obtaining new items through research.
[*]Almost every research and production is now queued. Meaning, you can queue up some tasks and go out for a good hunting.
[*]Control the power supply of the colony. Reduce the spread of infection rise.
[*]Mutant invasion! Mobs will try to invade into the Central control. It is do or die situation if you are invaded!
[*]The world doesn't wait for Dr.West. The game is now running a simulation of infection rise as well as evolution level at the colony level instead of per unit as before.
[/list]

[h1] Localization [/h1]

[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-h-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xap1/v/t1.0-9/10421413_875379235883407_7209372661870522521_n.jpg?oh=7976e82b911e611740e9048ba0268a88&oe=5675DAEB&__gda__=1449718327_4145329bc36f110eec7757c5a2122ba3[/img]

The whole game is now localizable and we now officially supports Russian. Passionate community members are working on them so we will soon have support for : 
[h1]French , German , Chinese , Japanese with Russian officially supported. [/h1]
More languages are possible!

[h1] Leaderboards [/h1]

[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-b-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xlf1/v/t1.0-9/11954845_875382659216398_1432031409655666181_n.jpg?oh=499322740656fd4ff72003a99896c0c6&oe=565F4DA9&__gda__=1450397910_7acfaa02bd0aa564f95c7aac65ea0492[/img]

Leader boards are now implemented. You can check it out in the community hub at the moment, but we will put some info in the main title in the future.
Check them out and see who is doing the best! More different types of leader boards will be implemented soon.

[h1] Please note [/h1]
The game play design is now final and we are now into polishing mode, finishing off the contents and polishing the game.

The tutorial is not up to date and we will update them once we have come back from BIC festival. (Next week)

We realize that this is huge change for the game. And we do realize that some players would prefer old version of the game. But please understand that we did this to finish the game within the budget and tried to focus on some specific game play designs instead of making the game too big and too ambitious.

[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-h-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xtp1/v/t1.0-9/11350838_875392315882099_4025076769132879590_n.jpg?oh=073cefee130e0d0038d44fc84e49857c&oe=56A35AB4&__gda__=1453536642_dbd3f2d8e62c9f9ec8c2d089d14a8584[/img]

notes.title: New "Base" game play mode!
notes.content:
Here is a sneak preview of what is now possible in the game
(Please beware that this is a spoiler!)
https://youtu.be/g5Aajw8VVj0

Wait if finally over, and we have just uploaded version 0.8 that is based on the new "Base" game play mode.

[h1]
The build is still in "Abyss" branch so you will have to enroll to that branch in order to play the updated content.
[/h1]

This is the very first build update so please consider the following : 

[list]
[*]There are still dummy place holder objects or empty rooms around the world.
[*]Weapon effects are not completed.
[*]Balance is probably horribly out of place.
[*]There will be tons of bugs.
[*]The final and grand ending is not yet implemented.
[*]Base security system not yet implemented.
[*]Some of the systems are not implemented yet, even it looks like it should. For example there are number of filters for oxygen controller but there effects are not yet implemented.
[*]Logs are not yet implemented.
[*]Random maps are still in development.
[/list]

Also consider the following before you play it :
[list]
[*]New tutorial is not yet implemented. So the game starts from base.
[*]We have given you some resources to start with.
[*]You will probably want to research the oxygen refills first.
[*]Credit is obsolete for now. Blueprint shop is gone.
[*]Gain access to new items through research.
[*]Press N key for your personal Map UI
[/list]

We realize that the game will need a lot of balancing and updates. But we don't want out players to wait for this update too long. So we are releasing the build in good faith that over the 

time the contents will be flashed out.

[h1]
Also, the localization for non-English language is not going to work. We will announce the new texts to be localized soon. So please play the game in English only.
[/h1]

As always we welcome any feedback.

Over the next few weeks, we are going to put in all other mobs and items for the end quest. We expect this game play mode to override the default old one in about 2-3 weeks.

Now that the initial build is up, we hope to return to our almost daily updates!

Thanks again for your patience!

notes.title: Version 0.7.5.0 major public update
notes.content:
Version 0.7.5.0 major public update

Release Note : Version 0.7.5.0   01 June 2015

Major public update.

Survival 

[h1]- New : Sitting[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Sit.jpg[/img]
West can sit on the chair, sofa or bench. Stamina recovery rate is increased while sitting.

[h1]- New : Sleeping[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Sleep.jpg[/img]
West can sleep on the bed. Time will pass quicker and sleepiness condition will improve. Rest status which gives reduced stamina requirement condition will be invoked upon waking up.

[h1]- New : Drink from a tap[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Tap.jpg[/img]
West can drink from a tap at the risk of contamination. It has limited supply of water and it does not refill.


Combat

[h1]- New : Dodge move[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Dodge.jpg[/img]
West has new move to dodge or quick step away from danger by pressing space bar and the movement keys. Dodge move will drain his stamina.

[h1]- New : Shield[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Shield.jpg[/img]
West can block attacks by equipping power pack and hold click right mouse button. It can absorb up to 50% of incoming damage. Shield will drain energy from power pack when it is turned on and drains extra energy when it is hit. Damage absorption amount and their effects are very much in open for development. 

[h1]- New : Power melee attack[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_PowerAttack.jpg[/img]
Melee attack move has changed from left mouse click to hold left mouse click and then release. Longer you hold the left mouse button more power West gathers before he releases to strike. You can gather the power up to 2 seconds which will result in 2x damage.


Graphics

[h1]- New : New style of fog.[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_NewFog.jpg[/img]
Fog area that are not visible to West is now represented by gray of the game background. West still needs to explore the area with his vision plus some lights to be able to unveil the fog so any undiscovered area will still be represented by the darkness. This may reduce some immersion feelings but we think it improves the overall visuals quite a bit. We can also introduce the pure black fog as before through option or on the game difficulty selection.

[h1]- New : Cocoon update.[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Cocoon.jpg[/img]
Cocoons are updated with the new sprites. Their physics behavior have also changed. Now they will be anchored at the fixed point on the ground, and only their core will move about. This will make player less likely get stuck by the cocoons. Their death effect has been updated too. Future plan for the cocoon is that when they die, they can spawn some mutants and when you go near them they may occasionally attack you with some kind of tentacles.

[h1]- New : Decals.[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Decal.jpg[/img]
We have started placing much needed decals on the map. This is part of the ongoing environment improvements. Soon, we want to turn these maggots into some kind of bio traps and add other types of dangers to the environment.

[h1]- New : Lighting option[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_LightOption.jpg[/img]
New graphics option - Lighting quality. (Low, Medium, High) This option can be used by a lower spec computer such as laptop with Intel HD 4000 graphics card to improve game performance. For a normal gaming pc, it shouldn’t have much effects at all and you can just set it to high. But with a low spec computer that has low GPU memory bandwidth, this option can improve game performance.
 
[h1]- New : Shop UI[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Shop.jpg[/img]
3D Printer shop UI has changed. Now, it accepts proper access cards as well as discount coupons. Access cards and coupons can be found throughout the game.

Other Notes :

- Changed : Max stamina is increased by 300%
- Melee attack kill can result in a better biomass drop yield.
- Added knock back force on melee attacks.
- Tutorial tips needs to be updated.
- Balancing needs to be tweaked as we have just introduced the new features.
- We have asked Valve for price adjustment approval. We have no idea when it will be approved.

notes.title: Version 0.7.3.7 released with new save options!
notes.content:
This release version has a new save options.

Ability to use these save options will be changed per difficulty options (which we are working on) but for now, we have unlocked for current mode.

Release Note : Version 0.7.3.7   12 May 2015

- Fixed : Scutum bug (can't enter rooms)

- Fixed : Pressing journal key (default j) opens journal when there was none.

- New : Save game in pause menu.

- New : Save points in the level to save the game.

[img]http://www.pixellore.com/Subterrain/Images/SavePoint.jpg[/img]

- New : Option to continue from last save game when you die without going back to main menu.

- New : Large power charger for terminal levels and new smaller ones at the hub levels. Max charge level for them are 1500 and 700 respectively. This should make energy requirement a bit easier.

- New : Keyboard remapping! This isn't fully GUI featured experience, but now you can remap the keyboard by changing settings.xml file (such as : C:\Users\saehoon\AppData\LocalLow\Pixellore\Subterrain\Settings\settings.xml ) If you break the setting by entering the same key or anything else, the game will overwrite the settings file with default one.

- Changed : medical item spawning chance at the medical bays.

On the next version, we will try to introduce first difficulty level selection and ability to skip tutorial levels.

Because of many core changes, your old save game may/may not work with this version. Thanks for your understanding.

Thanks everyone!
